visitRepo._note: Visit Repository is NOT a standalone array — it is DERIVED at runtime by flattening every farmer's visitLog[] into allVisitsRaw (lines 3052..3081). Each generated visit row has the shape below. The 'officer' field is taken from visitLog entry's 'by' — but the farmer visitLog entries DO NOT contain a 'by' key, so officer is undefined at runtime (data gap). visId starts at 2401 then is pre-incremented so first vid = 'VIS-2402'.

visitRecommendations._note: visitRecMap — keyed by visit purpose; each is an array of 3 recommendation cards {c:color, t:text}. Default fallback at line 3151 used when purpose has no map entry.

Crop inspection.t: Schedule follow-up spray advisory if pest activity confirmed. Coordinate with store for pesticide inventory.
Update crop health status in farmer profile. Flag for priority visit if severity is high.
Cross-check soil test report and recommend corrective fertiliser application for current crop stage.

Crop monitoring.t: Document crop growth stage and compare against expected calendar for the variety.
If weed or pest pressure observed, schedule product demo within 7 days.
Share monitoring report with Regional Manager for territory-level crop health tracking.

Product demo.t: Log farmer feedback and interest level. Raise a lead if purchase intent is high.
Ensure demo product batch details are recorded. Coordinate dispatch from store for trial order.
Follow up within 10 days to assess trial results and close conversion opportunity.

Product delivery.t: Confirm product receipt and application plan with the farmer. Note any usage queries.
Schedule a crop response check-in visit 2–3 weeks after application.
Update invoice record in farmer profile. Link to purchase history for LTV tracking.

Follow-up.t: Resolve the outstanding action item from the previous visit before closing this follow-up.
Reassess the lead status based on engagement level. Update in Farmer 360.
Confirm next visit date and specific objective before leaving the field.

First visit.t: Complete full farmer profile registration. Capture land, crop, soil, and commercial data.
Assess lead potential and assign segment (High/Medium/New) based on land size and purchase history.
Share UA product catalogue and introduce store point of contact. Offer soil testing service.

Sowing advisory.t: Confirm seed variety recommended matches soil type and season. Document in farmer notes.
Coordinate with store for seed availability and timely delivery before sowing window closes.
Schedule a 4-week post-sowing visit to assess germination and nutrient requirement.

Harvest planning.t: Estimate yield and connect farmer with procurement or FPO channel if applicable.
Discuss next season crop plan and pre-book inputs. Create advance order from store.
Capture harvest outcome data for analytics and territory performance reporting.

Re-engagement.t: Understand reason for disengagement. Document competitive products being used.
Offer loyalty benefit or personalised input recommendation to rebuild trust.
Set 30-day re-engagement milestone. Escalate to Regional Manager if farmer remains unresponsive.

Season review.t: Document season summary: yield estimate, input usage, issues faced, and satisfaction score.
Plan next-season input requirement and create advance order. Lock pricing where possible.
Flag high-performing farmers for FPO enrollment or contract farming discussion.

Soil advisory.t: Share soil test results in simplified form. Recommend specific amendments or fertiliser plan.
Coordinate organic/bio compost availability from store. Offer application demo if needed.
Re-test soil after 60 days to validate improvement. Document corrective action taken.

Pest check.t: Identify pest/disease accurately. Apply first-aid treatment if on-hand and advise immediate action.
Coordinate with store for targeted pesticide. Ensure correct dosage and safety protocol.
Re-visit within 7 days to assess treatment efficacy and prevent crop loss escalation.

_default.t: Schedule a follow-up visit within 14 days to assess outcomes from this visit.
Update farmer profile with visit outcome and any changes to lead status.
Coordinate any product or input requirements with the assigned store for timely dispatch.

asrs._note: ASR/officer performance leaderboard. Computed extras: rank=i+1, rankColor (top3 #F9A825 else #BDBDBD), scoreColor & barColor by score thresholds (>=80 green, >=70 amber, else orange).

regions._note: Regional performance. visitPct used for bar width.

landSegments._note: Analytics 'segments' array — land-holding size buckets (distinct from farmer value segments). Variable name in source is `segments`.

kpis._note: kpiData lives in state and is editable via the KPI edit modal. The kpis array maps kpiData into 4 display cards.

leads._note: Lead Pipeline kanban columns. items are filtered from the farmers array by farmer.status (NOT a separate dataset). NOTE the columns filter on f.status with values New/Contacted/Follow-up/Converted; some farmers have status='High Value' or 'Dormant' which fall into no column.

clusters._note: Farmer Clusters are fully runtime-generated — state.farmerClusters starts as [] (no demo clusters). createCluster() (3356..3369) builds a cluster object from the current map layer + store filter. Shape documented below for the data layer.

segments._note: Farmer VALUE segment label/colour maps used across Farmer 360, map legend, lookup, etc.

segCards._note: Segmentation summary cards. revenue = '₹'+round(sum(f.totalPurchase)/1000)+'K total revenue' — but farmers have NO totalPurchase field, so revenue computes to '₹NaNK' / '₹0K' at runtime (data gap).

stores._note: Store master data (baseStores). 6 stores. Each has officers[] and a bdm{}. left/top are map percentage positions. farmerIds map store→farmers (used by farmerStoreMap). Note baseStores left/top differ from the separate map pinPositions array.
